The Lab/2014

c. August 2014 · Design & development

Agrobot & Cropstor

Two agricultural product concepts, complete with interfaces, branding and motion.

From the archive

The surviving product pages and assets are timestamped 1 August 2014. This dates the recovered edition, not a verified public launch.

Agrobot presented a sensor-based irrigation system with moisture tracking. Cropstor approached the other end of the process with a warehouse interface for recording farmers and their produce.

The JAD project brought the two ideas into one visual world. Product pages, phone mockups, interface screens and short videos survive from the competition work.
